vllm_reference.note: Frozen combined experiment runtime, not the unchanged checked-in src tree.

same_semantics: Request-local and layer-local 14-bucket non-decaying distance profile; the entire current packet is included before expected mass is computed.
Row distance uses original document coordinates. Expected mass is normalized across visible physical segments in each row.
Mass and expected share exp2(-delta/half_life) decay; lift=mass/expected, unseen pages rank above scored pages, with the original all-nonpositive fallback.
Physical duplicates contribute separate attention/expectation; exposure is counted once per logical key per sampled row.
At the final Query the first four full-attention layers share a global Mean-K selection; deeper layers use their fresh per-layer Q after preceding layers execute.

Mean-K scoring uses normalized pre-RoPE Q and K, FP16 represented operands, softmax across eligible pages per token/head, then sums query tokens and averages heads/layers. Query tokens are not averaged before softmax.

differences.vllm: 32-token statistics, Mean-K and selected pages; distance subtracts key_start+32.
differences.ninfer: 64-token statistics, Mean-K and selected pages in the current run; distance subtracts key_start+64.
differences.effect: Material: different attention aggregation, distance buckets, page-softmax domain and selection freedom. Formula parity does not imply equal selected tokens.

differences.vllm: Runtime default remains 8192; documented combined launch explicitly sets 32768.
differences.ninfer: Selecting lift automatically defaults to 32768; optional positive override.
differences.effect: Matched at 32768 in the intended combined settings; setting only the vLLM lift scorer would not match.

differences.vllm: from_values and values-based restore/pruning drop lift/expected/profile. FAST_STATE immutable StateRows can retain them, but same_state/rows identity omit the lift fields.
differences.ninfer: Expected, profile and mode are included in snapshot copies, checkpoint identity, compatibility validation and metadata accounting.
differences.effect: Material for affected restore/GC paths; current one-turn no-prefix-reuse NIAH run does not test vLLM session restore.

differences.vllm: KVMEM_LAYERWISE_QUERY_GLOBAL_LAYERS=N selects the first N full-attention layers.
differences.ninfer: NINFER_LAYERWISE_GLOBAL_QUERY=1 selects model layers at or below 15.
differences.effect: Equivalent for the tested 27B model: layers 3,7,11,15. Not a generic same-N API for other layer layouts.

differences.vllm: Batched and deferred native state folding through the Python runtime.
differences.ninfer: Host C++ packet acceptance and native snapshot ownership, using the existing Ada/SM120 attention capture path.
differences.effect: Different scheduling and backend arithmetic; no claim that cross-backend Q/K/V or end-to-end outputs are bit-identical.

limitations: Synthetic attention packets; this is an isolated scoring check, not an end-to-end backend accuracy comparison.
The NInfer core accepts 32-token geometry here for comparison; its actual serving run still uses physical 64-token pages.
Lift expected values and bucket profiles are private in the upstream extension; its public mass/exposure/score outputs are compared.
cpu_differential.selection_reference: Top half sorted from the actual vLLM native State.scores_for output, compared with the NInfer core actual resident-only picker; no mandatory sink in this synthetic fixture.
